snippet.title: Football Challenge / Soccer Challenge (V.Smile) - Full Game HD Walkthrough - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Includes the full game: the V.Smile Cup, the Learning Adventure, all 3 Learning Zone mini-games and Friendly Play. Played on the original VTech's V.Smile console, recorded with Elgato HD60. 

If you enjoyed watching this video, please leave a like and subscribe! I would very much appreciate it!

Football Challenge / Soccer Challenge (V.Smile) playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYwqV0N4djf99pXRp0bidzrMpsG5PZu-G

V.Smile | V.Motion | V.Flash/Pro | V.Smile Baby Games playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYwqV0N4djf8t8BHTgTUdCfEJxO3vk9ao

Summary: With V Smile Soccer Challenge, you can travel to eight different countries to collect team players, play world-class soccer, and shop in the sport shop all while learning! Curriculum includes soccer game play and strategy, numbers and counting, mathematics, object identification, problem solving, food and nutrition, spelling and vocabulary. Mike loves soccer and his goal is to play in the V.Smile Cup. But first he needs to build a great soccer team. Mikes coach suggests that he find four teammates from around the world to create his very own dream team.In V Smile Soccer Challenge, you'll tour different countries and meet soccer players from around the globe. You'll play exciting games and overcome cool challenges to improve your soccer skills. Help Mike build a powerful soccer team and then play hard to win the V.Smile Cup!

Release Date - June 20, 2006
Genre - Football, Platformer, Adventure
Platforms - V.Smile, V.Smile Motion, V.Smile Pocket
Publisher - VTech
Developer - VTech

My Xbox gamertag: TGG Yari
My PlayStation gamertag: ToughGamingGuyYT
My Steam: ToughGamingGuy

Wanna see more of my fantastic walkthroughs? Give it a go: https://www.youtube.com/user/ToughGamingGuy
